description: This PHP source file manages the editing interface for the reqMgrSystem component in the TestLink project, including rendering GUI templates, handling user actions, initializing script parameters, and checking user permissions.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering the GUI based on user actions, either by displaying a template or redirecting.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes the script by creating command manager, arguments, and GUI state.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments based on a whitelist.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI state, including user permissions and related test projects.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the reqMgrSystem management functions.
